name: High Noon
description: On attack, has a %chance% % chance to mark the target enemy. Attacks on a marked enemy do not consume an action. Attacking a marked enemy causes it to take %crit_damage% % damage, and consumes the mark.
details: Only the unit who caused the mark can consume the mark.
Failed attacks do not consume the mark.

upgrade.summary: Gains an active component. Unleashes a flurry of bullets at the target.
upgrade.description: On cast, attacks %count% times at the targetted unit. If a mark is consumed during these attacks, an additional attack is added.
